head: c30e5eb2
headSubject: fix(crud): REG-308 -- a REST update carrying a version is a real compare-and-swap
summary: REG-308 fixed and pushed (c30e5eb2): a REST update carrying a version reads the ConceptRecord and forwards the loaded row_version as the gateway write's expectedRowVersion (CAS under the row lock) and as the final save's guard; a lost race is the same 409 version_conflict (GeneratedCrudRuntimeSupport.guardVersionConflict/writeWithRowVersion). New run_probes.py step type 'concurrent' + probe reg308-concurrent-same-version-puts-exactly-one-wins (80-enforcement-demo.json): 8 same-version PUTs -> 1x200 + 7x409; InMemory 135/135, h2local 138/138; red against the pre-fix template (200x3, 409x1, 500x4). Lesson: RuntimeHost's coverage ratchet counts executable lines the generated service gains (ContactMessageServiceBase is 252/287 missed; the suite barely touches CRUD), so template growth must land in runtime-support, not in service-base.mustache. Both old stashes dropped (patches archived in OutsideRepo/branch-archive). All 5 gates green incl. paperwork.
nextStep: Only OWN-2 (owner outreach) and AIP-4 4.5 (needs Tauri/Rust toolchain) remain open; neither is startable without the owner. Optional hardening: a concept that is not kernelControlled AND has an update flow still has the REG-308 window; and fl-monitor-reports-compensated-execution (20-flow.json) flaked once on InMemory (history items[0] was a newer COMPLETED execution) -- passed 28/28 alone, file a ledger item if it recurs.
